name: Code Quality

# 触发时机：main 与 codex 工作分支推送；保留已有平台事件兼容配置
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, 'codex/**']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
  GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.longpaths
  GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'true'

jobs:
  # ─── Windows 源码行尾治理 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  windows-line-ending-governance:
    name: Windows 源码 LF 检出治理
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: 检出代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 验证源码在索引和 Windows 工作树中均为 LF
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $patterns = @(
            '*.ts',
            '*.tsx',
            '*.mts',
            '*.cts',
            '*.js',
            '*.jsx',
            '*.mjs',
            '*.cjs'
          )

          $eolState = git ls-files --eol -- $patterns ':(exclude)docs/archive/**' ':(exclude).patch-backups/**' ':(exclude).specforge/**'
          $violations = @(
            $eolState | Where-Object {
              $_ -notmatch '^i/lf\s+w/lf\s+attr/text eol=lf\s+'
            }
          )

          if ($violations.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-Error '以下源码文件未同时满足 index=LF、Windows worktree=LF、attribute=eol=lf：'
            $violations | ForEach-Object { Write-Error $_ }
            exit 1
          }

          Write-Host "Validated $($eolState.Count) source files: index=LF, worktree=LF, attribute=eol=lf."

  # ─── 异步资源规范审查 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async-resource-audit:
    name: 异步资源规范审查
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: 检出代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: 安装 Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: '1.3.14'
      - name: 安装依赖
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: 运行异步资源规范审查
        run: bun run scripts/audit-async-resources.ts
        # 脚本发现 error 级别问题时返回 exit code 1，GitHub Actions 自动标记失败

  # ─── 工作流文档同步检查 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  workflow-docs-sync:
    name: 工作流文档同步检查
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: 检出代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: 安装 Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: '1.3.14'
      - name: 安装依赖
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Verify workflow docs in sync with JSON
        run: bun run check-workflows

  # Actual full regression and complete lint on every supported host.
  test:
    name: Full lint/build/regression (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    env:
      SPECFORGE_CI_REPORT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/specforge-full-regression
    steps:
      - name: 检出代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: 安装 Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24.19.0'
      - name: 安装 Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: '1.3.14'
      - name: Bind pinned Windows verification Node
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: '"SPECFORGE_VERIFICATION_NODE_SOURCE=$((Get-Command node).Source)" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV'
      - name: 安装依赖
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: 构建当前发布 workspace
        run: node scripts/run-ci-regression.mjs build
      - name: 完整 ESLint
        run: node scripts/run-ci-regression.mjs lint
      - name: 运行当前发布 workspace 测试
        run: node scripts/run-ci-regression.mjs workspace
      - name: 运行当前 Root 测试
        run: node scripts/run-ci-regression.mjs root
      - name: Upload complete raw regression evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: full-regression-evidence-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/specforge-full-regression
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  # ─── 硬编码路径 Lint ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  lint-hardcoded-paths:
    name: 硬编码路径 Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: 检出代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: 安装 Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: '1.3.14'
      - name: 安装依赖
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: 运行硬编码路径 Lint
        run: bun run scripts/lint/check-hardcoded-paths.ts

  # ─── 目录布局一致性检查 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  render-layout-consistency:
    name: 目录布局一致性检查
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: 检出代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: 安装 Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: '1.3.14'
      - name: 安装依赖
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: 生成目录布局
        run: bun run scripts/render-layout.ts
      - name: 检查生成物与提交一致
        run: git diff --exit-code -- README.md AGENTS.md docs/conventions/directory-layout.md
